title: Dedicated Storybook Dev Commands
description: Add dedicated dev commands for Storybook so developers can choose technology level and bundle level, such as dev storybook, dev storybook compose, and dev storybook compose ui. Follow bun, nx, script.ts command conventions and validate the commands.
summary: Added scope-aware root Storybook dev routing, wired Storybook config to load scoped story globs from STORYBOOK_SCOPE, and added Nx/package dev aliases for workspace, compose, compose/ui, compose/algorithms, elements, elements/ui, and elements/board Storybook slices. Validated JSON parsing, Nx project metadata, scoped parser rejection for unknown scopes, direct compose/ui Storybook smoke test, and Nx emoji compose/ui Storybook smoke test.
